notes: One socket, two streams: quote (price, OHLC, volume, OI, best bid and ask) for every subscription, quote2 (the five-level book and its totals) for Depth subscriptions; the fields of both are merged per symbol.
Indices stream by Samco's listingId (-23), fetched by the web at subscribe from /quote/indexQuote; the desktop learns it from a REST index quote (audit RB-05).

Order updates: Samco has no order stream; the web and the desktop poll the order book (web PollingOrderUpdateAdapter, desktop brokers::common::order_poll). No corpus case until the harness can serve a scripted order book (lead decision, 2026-11-09).
